definitions.explanation: A person who creates visual art such as painting, sculpture, or other fine arts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{美術家|びじゅつか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw works by a famous artist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{美術家|びじゅつか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: She was recognized as an artist at a young age.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美術家|びじゅつか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧、⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アート→アート：10713_aato⟧⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り{上|あ}げている→作り上げる：11569_tsukuriageru⟧。
examples.english: Many artists gather in this town and have built a unique art scene.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (fine art) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional suffix). Refers specifically to practitioners of visual or fine arts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧{美術家|びじゅつか}: contemporary artist
- {美術家|びじゅつか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work as an artist
- {美術家|びじゅつか}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: artists' association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{芸術家|げいじゅつか}→芸術家：14979_geijutsuka⟧: artist (broader) — covers all arts including music, literature, and performance
- ⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧: painter — specifically someone who paints
- ⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧: artist (loanword) — broader and more casual; often used for musicians and performers too
